title: cocode.build (command)
description: Put the real program in the Build pane. It replaces any earlier build; the pane marks it stale by itself once the editor's rev moves past this one. status defaults to ready. building shows a spinner and may carry no code. failed shows notes as the reason. Streams append code chunks.

rev.description: The document revision this program was built for.

lang.description: The language of the real program, e.g. python.

code.description: The runnable program (a chunk when streaming).

file.description: A file name for the program, e.g. welcome.py.

notes.description: Shown under the code; the reason when status is failed.

seq.description: Chunk order when streaming; code chunks append.

done.description: true on the last chunk of a stream.
